title: Exempt Taxi Drivers Who have Taken Medical Assessments for Personal Licence from Retaking Same Tests for Vocational Licence within Same Year
what_it_is: Exempt Taxi Drivers Who have Taken Medical Assessments for Personal Licence from Retaking Same Tests for Vocational Licence within Same Year

sections.label: Taxi driver medical assessments
sections.summary: LTA requires older taxi drivers to pass medical exams with occupation-related checks to renew their Taxi Driver Vocational Licences, and is aligning this with Traffic Police assessments.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Among these older drivers who wish to drive a taxi, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) requires them to also pass a medical examination with additional occupation-related health checks to certify their fitness to renew their Taxi Driver Vocational Licences (TDVL).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: We subject taxi drivers to more stringent medical assessment as they clock a much higher mileage than other motorists.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: LTA is working with the Traffic Police to align the two medical assessment processes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Before the end of this year, taxi drivers who have passed their TDVL medical assessments should be able to use them to renew their Class 3 personal driving licences.

sections.label: Heavy vehicle and taxi test fees
sections.summary: A resident said the Traffic Police's enhanced Heavy Vehicle Proficiency Test fee is about $450, while LTA's enhanced Taxi Driver's Vocational Licence test is $136.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: According to my resident, for Class 4 and 5, the Traffic Police's enhanced Heavy Vehicle Proficiency Test fee is about $450.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: LTA's enhanced Taxi Driver's Vocational Licence test is $136.

sections.label: Driver incomes and interventions
sections.summary: Many drivers reported income reductions of as much as 50%, and the test fees will be considered while working with the association under the tripartite model.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Many of them have given feedback that their incomes have been reduced by as much as 50%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We will take the test fees into consideration.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Some are directed at the drivers and some are directed at the operators.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We will continue to work closely with the association, in line with the tripartite model, to look and see what is the effectiveness of the interventions we put in place and to see whether or not further interventions are necessary.
